subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: If enforcement is attempted while the operator's recorded activation acts are absent — the org backstop change and the ratified AUTO-eligible class set — then the merge lane shall refuse to act and shall route every proposal HUMAN.
rationale: the fail-closed activation gate: the boundary moves only by the operator's hand (A-1)
fit_criterion: with activation absent, no fixture — however floor-clear — produces a lane act; the refusal names the missing act
